decision.observation: 10 mph, gear R, timer 42:43.179. The extended reverse carried the car well off the gravel into a stand of pines; the road with its white fence lies up-frame and to the left, about two car lengths away, and the nose now points up-frame toward trees bordering the road.
decision.hypothesis: Continuing reverse pushes deeper into the pines, whereas the nose already points up-frame toward the road's run, so a plain-W conversion should carry the car forward along that heading back toward the gravel.
decision.memory: A second reverse beat after clearing a fence over-shot: the car travelled ~2-3 car lengths and ended in the pine stand beside the white-fence corner. Cap the post-fence reverse at one 1.5 s hold, then convert.
